why: Mount Sharp boxwork region, Gale Crater: Curiosity drove through it from about sol 4578 (June 2025) to sol 4850 (early 2026), sites 117-121; sols 4636 and 4722 are documented boxwork sols. The 2 km square also holds the approach from the north-east (sols ~4480-4570) and the exit to the south (sols ~4850-4930).
source: Rover positions from NASA/JPL MMGIS waypoints, https://mars.nasa.gov/mmgis-maps/MSL/Layers/json/MSL_waypoints.json

dem_footprint.note: Inside the USGS MSL Gale 1 m DEM mosaic footprint (lat -5.10 to -4.13, lon 137.12 to 137.68).
